about.label: ABOUT ME
about.title: Frontend Developer building products that people actually use
paragraphs: I'm Lawrence, a Frontend Developer based in Abuja. I specialize in turning complex problems into simple, beautiful, and intuitive interfaces.
Currently building NigaJobs — a full-stack job platform for Nigeria, and Log-X Hotel — a modern booking website. I care about performance, accessibility, and clean code that scales.
